boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Pennsylvania State University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations with currently posted late hours in State College.

cards.title: Penn State Halal Guys
cards.subtitle: 417 E Calder Way, State College
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page to confirm the day’s schedule, then stop by the Calder Way counter for takeout or delivery.
cards.short_summary: A downtown halal-food option posted until 3 a.m. on most days.
cards.evidence_claim: The business lists 417 E Calder Way and hours until 3 a.m. Monday through Friday and Sunday.
cards.source_title: Penn State Halal Guys
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Monday–Friday 10 a.m.–3 a.m.; Saturday 10 a.m.–midnight; Sunday midnight–3 a.m.

cards.title: Sher Halal Gyro
cards.subtitle: 137 E Beaver Ave, State College
cards.notes: Walk to the East Beaver Avenue food cart and check its official page before heading out, since it is closed Sundays.
cards.short_summary: A downtown food-cart stop with late posted hours Monday through Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Sher Halal Gyro lists its cart at 137 E Beaver Ave and hours of 11 a.m.–3 a.m. Monday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Sher Halal Gyro — Location & Hours
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Monday–Saturday 11 a.m.–3 a.m.; Sunday closed.

cards.title: Raising Cane's on East College
cards.subtitle: 228 E College Ave, State College
cards.notes: Confirm the posted day before going; dine-in hours extend later on Friday and Saturday than on the rest of the week.
cards.short_summary: A College Avenue restaurant open through midnight daily and later on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s lists this location at 228 E College Ave, open until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's — E College Ave
cards.access_notes: Posted dine-in hours: 10 a.m.–midnight Sunday–Thursday; 10 a.m.–2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: 421 E Beaver Ave, Suite G2, State College
cards.notes: Check the listed hours before walking over; the shop’s Thursday through Saturday schedule runs later than its early-week hours.
cards.short_summary: A dessert stop with posted 3 a.m. closing times on selected nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Apple Maps lists Insomnia Cookies at 421 E Beaver Ave, Suite G2, with 3 a.m. closing Thursday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Apple Maps — Insomnia Cookies, State College
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 1 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday; 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.

cards.title: Yallah Taco on East College
cards.subtitle: 310 E College Ave, State College
cards.notes: Use Yallah Taco’s location page to check the schedule, especially if planning a Friday or Saturday pickup after midnight.
cards.short_summary: An East College Avenue taco stop with posted late weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Yallah Taco’s official dinner page lists its 310 E College Ave location open until 2:30 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Yallah Taco — Dinner
cards.access_notes: Posted hours on the location page include Friday and Saturday 9:30 a.m.–2:30 a.m.; hours vary by day.

cards.title: Canyon Pizza
cards.subtitle: 219 E Beaver Ave, State College
cards.notes: Check the day-specific carryout schedule before ordering; the official site lists separate evening windows on several weekdays.
cards.short_summary: A Beaver Avenue pizza shop with late carryout windows every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Canyon Pizza lists 219 E Beaver Ave and carries hours as late as 3 a.m. Saturday, with late-night carryout windows throughout the week.
cards.source_title: Canyon Pizza
cards.access_notes: Posted carryout closes 2 a.m. Tuesday–Thursday, 2:30 a.m. Friday, 3 a.m. Saturday, and 2 a.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Benny Leone's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 109 S Fraser St, State College
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s ordering page to confirm availability, then head to Fraser Street for pickup during its listed evening window.
cards.short_summary: A Fraser Street pizza counter listing service until 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Benny Leone’s Pizza lists its address as 109 S Fraser St and posted hours of 11 a.m.–1 a.m.
cards.source_title: Benny Leone's Pizza
cards.access_notes: The official ordering page displays hours of 11 a.m.–1 a.m.; confirm the current day’s service before leaving.

cards.title: Taco Bell on North Atherton
cards.subtitle: 1909 N Atherton St, State College
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s official page before traveling north of campus; it lists both dine-in and drive-thru service late nightly.
cards.short_summary: A North Atherton location with posted 3 a.m. service daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists 1909 North Atherton Street with dine-in and drive-thru hours of 9 a.m.–3 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 1909 North Atherton Street
cards.access_notes: Posted drive-thru hours: 9 a.m.–3 a.m. daily; the page also lists dine-in service until 3 a.m.

cards.title: Papa Johns on North Atherton
cards.subtitle: 2110 N Atherton St, State College
cards.notes: Place a delivery or carryout order through the location page, checking the posted schedule for the later Thursday through Saturday window.
cards.short_summary: A North Atherton pizza location with 1 a.m. carryout on select nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists 2110 N Atherton St and delivery and carryout until 1 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns — N Atherton St
cards.access_notes: Posted delivery and carryout hours: until midnight Sunday–Wednesday and until 1 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.

cards.title: McDonald's on East College
cards.subtitle: 2821 E College Ave, State College
cards.notes: Use the official locator to verify the current schedule and choose lobby or drive-thru service before making the East College Avenue trip.
cards.short_summary: An East College Avenue restaurant listing midnight closing every day.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s lists its 2821 E College Ave restaurant and drive-thru as open until midnight daily.
cards.source_title: McDonald's — 2821 E College Ave
cards.access_notes: Posted restaurant and drive-thru hours: 5 a.m.–midnight daily.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named University Park destinations for studying, making, viewing art, gathering, or informal recreation, each supported by a direct Penn State source.

cards.title: HUB-Robeson Center
cards.subtitle: 288 Pollock Road
cards.notes: Use the central gathering space to meet classmates, attend a campus event, or locate student organizations and services between commitments.
cards.short_summary: A central campus building for student organizations, events, collaboration, and connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Student Affairs describes the HUB–Robeson Center as its central campus gathering space, bringing together students, organizations, and resources.
cards.source_title: HUB-Robeson Center | Penn State Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Consult the HUB page or building staff for event-specific access and room availability.

cards.title: Engagement Space
cards.subtitle: HUB-Robeson Center
cards.notes: Stop by to explore out-of-classroom opportunities and ask staff about goals, engagement options, and next steps for getting involved.
cards.short_summary: A staffed HUB space focused on helping students explore engagement opportunities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Engagement Network says its University Park Engagement Space in the HUB is equipped with tools and staff to help students identify goals and opportunities.
cards.source_title: Engagement Space at University Park | Student Engagement Network
cards.access_notes: Located in the HUB-Robeson Center; check the Student Engagement Network for current programming.

cards.title: HUB-Robeson Galleries
cards.subtitle: HUB Gallery, Art Alley, and first-floor exhibition cases
cards.notes: Take a self-guided art break in the HUB Gallery, Art Alley, or exhibition cases; personal photography is encouraged unless posted otherwise.
cards.short_summary: Rotating contemporary-art and student-facing exhibitions distributed through the HUB.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State states that exhibitions in the HUB Gallery, Art Alley, exhibition cases, and public HUB spaces are free and open to all.
cards.source_title: HUB-Robeson Galleries | Penn State Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Listed gallery hours are Monday through Friday, 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; exhibitions rotate.

cards.title: Pattee and Paterno Libraries
cards.subtitle: Library study spaces and computer labs
cards.notes: Settle into a study area, use computers or printers, and check the library’s current services before planning a group work session.
cards.short_summary: The main University Park library complex supports individual and group academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State IT lists computer labs, hallway stations, and printers in Pattee/Paterno Library, and the Libraries describe study and collaboration spaces there.
cards.source_title: Computer Lab Locations | Penn State Information Technology
cards.access_notes: Penn State IT publishes current computer-lab hours; library access and services can vary by term.

cards.title: Collaboration Commons
cards.subtitle: Ground floor, Pattee and Paterno Libraries
cards.notes: Use this ground-floor library area when you need a collaborative setting, then check the Libraries’ reservation system for eligible study rooms.
cards.short_summary: A named library area designed around group study, collaboration, and technology-supported work.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State identifies the Collaboration Commons as a ground-floor space in Pattee and Paterno Libraries and describes its study and collaboration functions.
cards.source_title: Pattee Library renovation to expand student study, collaboration spaces | Penn State
cards.access_notes: Group-study room access and reservations are subject to current University Libraries policies.

cards.title: Palmer Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: 650 Bigler Road
cards.notes: Browse current exhibitions at your own pace, or look for a scheduled drop-in tour, gallery talk, workshop, or Art After Hours program.
cards.short_summary: Penn State’s campus art museum, next to the Arboretum on Bigler Road.
cards.evidence_claim: The Palmer Museum of Art is located at 650 Bigler Road on Penn State’s University Park campus and offers free admission with a suggested donation.
cards.source_title: Palmer Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: The museum lists Wednesday–Sunday hours and Thursday evening hours; it is closed Monday, Tuesday, and University holidays.

cards.title: The Arboretum at Penn State
cards.subtitle: East Park Avenue and Bigler Road
cards.notes: Walk the H.O. Smith Botanic Gardens or the surrounding Arboretum grounds during daylight, and use the official maps to choose a route.
cards.short_summary: A mapped botanical landscape at the northeast edge of the University Park campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arboretum is open daily from dawn to dusk, and Penn State states there is no admission charge for its botanic gardens or land beyond them.
cards.source_title: Hours, Admission, Directions, Parking | The Arboretum at Penn State
cards.access_notes: Open every day from dawn until dusk; observe posted visitor policies and use official Arboretum maps.

cards.title: Alumni Gardens
cards.subtitle: Around the Hintz Family Alumni Center
cards.notes: Walk the connected garden areas, ponds, and waterfall, then pause at a seating area while staying on the maintained paths and respecting events.
cards.short_summary: A one-acre cluster of named garden areas beside the alumni center.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Alumni Association says the Alumni Gardens surround the Hintz Family Alumni Center and include five distinct garden areas; its visitor page notes students and community members gather there.
cards.source_title: Hintz Family Alumni Center | Penn State Alumni Association
cards.access_notes: The gardens surround an active alumni-center facility; be mindful of scheduled functions and posted guidance.

cards.title: Outdoor Pickleball Courts
cards.subtitle: Beside McCoy Natatorium on Curtin Road
cards.notes: Bring a friend for informal play at the courts beside McCoy Natatorium, and plan your visit within the published daylight operating window.
cards.short_summary: Twelve outdoor courts for informal pickleball near the natatorium.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Campus Recreation identifies twelve Outdoor Pickleball Courts beside McCoy Natatorium on Curtin Road and says they are open daily from sunup to sundown for informal play.
cards.source_title: Recreation Facilities | Penn State Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Open daily from sunup to sundown for informal play; follow current Campus Recreation facility guidelines.

cards.title: Park Avenue Intramural Fields
cards.subtitle: North of East Halls
cards.notes: Gather a group for informal outdoor play in this grass complex, and check Campus Recreation information for scheduled intramural activity or reservations.
cards.short_summary: A 12-acre grass field complex north of East Halls for activities and informal play.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Campus Recreation identifies the Park Avenue Intramural Fields as a 12-acre grass complex north of East Halls that hosts intramural competitions, student activities, and informal play.
cards.source_title: Recreation Facilities | Penn State Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Campus Recreation lists this area for intramural competitions, student activities, informal play, and reservations.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission campus cultural stops for an under-21-safe outing at University Park.

cards.title: Walk the Palmer Museum galleries
cards.subtitle: Palmer Museum of Art · University Park campus
cards.notes: Meet at the museum entrance, check in at the front desk, then move through the galleries together at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: A free museum stop beside the Arboretum with gallery space for a low-key group visit.
cards.evidence_claim: The Palmer Museum states that admission is free and no prior reservation is required.
cards.source_title: Palmer Museum of Art — Visitor Information
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday–Sunday; check the museum page before going. Visitors check in at the front desk; no reservation is required.

cards.entity_name: Earth and Mineral Sciences Museum & Art Gallery
cards.title: Browse fossils and mineral-industry art
cards.subtitle: Earth and Mineral Sciences Museum & Art Gallery · Deike Building
cards.notes: Start on Deike Building’s ground floor, pick a few exhibits to discuss, and use the benches for a relaxed shared stop.
cards.short_summary: A free, public geology-and-art gallery where photography and sketching are encouraged.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum says its University Park exhibition gallery is open to everyone and always free of charge.
cards.source_title: EMS Museum & Art Gallery — Visit
cards.access_notes: Located on the Deike Building ground floor; normal hours are Monday–Friday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m.

cards.title: Take a garden walk at the Arboretum
cards.subtitle: The Arboretum at Penn State · beside University Park campus
cards.notes: Choose a loop through the gardens and natural areas, pause at the overlooks, and keep the outing within dawn-to-dusk access.
cards.short_summary: A 370-acre garden and natural-space walk with free daily admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Outreach states that the Arboretum is open every day from dawn until dusk and admission is free.
cards.source_title: Penn State Outreach — The Arboretum at Penn State
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn until dusk; stay on established paths and observe posted garden guidance.

cards.title: See the current HUB Gallery show
cards.subtitle: HUB Gallery · HUB-Robeson Center, University Park
cards.notes: Meet inside the HUB-Robeson Center, view the current installation together, and use the gallery’s posted schedule for timing.
cards.short_summary: A daily public art-gallery stop in the student union.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State says the HUB Gallery is open daily from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. and admission is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Penn State News — HUB-Robeson Galleries present 'Feral Botanica'
cards.access_notes: The cited exhibition is listed through October 31, 2026; gallery hours are 10 a.m.–6 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Visit the Special Collections exhibition
cards.subtitle: Eberly Family Special Collections Library · 104 Paterno Library
cards.notes: Head to room 104, browse the exhibition cases together, and leave time to compare one item each that caught your eye.
cards.short_summary: A free public exhibition in Paterno Library centered on rare and unique materials.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State states that the Special Collections exhibition in 104 Paterno Library is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Penn State News — Special Collections Library exhibition
cards.access_notes: The cited exhibition runs through May 13, 2026; verify a current exhibition and library access before visiting.

cards.title: Look through Penn State sports history
cards.subtitle: All-Sports Museum · adjacent to Beaver Stadium
cards.notes: Plan a museum stop with friends, move through the memorabilia displays, and check the museum’s current visitor information before travel.
cards.short_summary: A campus museum focused on Penn State athletics history and memorabilia.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Sustainability states that all University museums and cultural sites have free public access and identifies the All-Sports Museum as a University Park museum.
cards.source_title: Penn State Sustainability — SDG 11
cards.access_notes: Free public access is stated by Penn State; confirm current museum hours before visiting.

cards.title: Explore the historic Armsby Calorimeter
cards.subtitle: Armsby Respiration Calorimeter Museum · University Park campus
cards.notes: Coordinate a visit around current museum availability, then take time to examine the historic scientific apparatus and interpretive material.
cards.short_summary: A historic-science museum stop centered on the Armsby calorimeter.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State identifies the Armsby Respiration Calorimeter Museum as a University Park museum and states that all University museums and cultural sites have free public access.
cards.source_title: Penn State Sustainability — SDG 11
cards.access_notes: Free public access is stated by Penn State; confirm current museum access and hours in advance.

cards.title: Examine insect collections at Frost
cards.subtitle: Frost Entomological Museum · University Park campus
cards.notes: Check visitor availability first, then browse the insect displays as a group and use labels as prompts for a quick scavenger hunt.
cards.short_summary: A University Park museum devoted to entomological collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State identifies the Frost Entomological Museum as a University Park museum and states that all University museums and cultural sites have free public access.
cards.source_title: Penn State Sustainability — SDG 11
cards.access_notes: Free public access is stated by Penn State; verify current visitor hours and entry details before going.

cards.title: Browse anthropology displays at Matson
cards.subtitle: Matson Museum of Anthropology · University Park campus
cards.notes: Verify the museum’s current access details, then walk the displays together and choose one object to discuss before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A campus museum visit for viewing anthropology collections and exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State identifies the Matson Museum of Anthropology as a University Park museum and states that all University museums and cultural sites have free public access.
cards.source_title: Penn State Sustainability — SDG 11
cards.access_notes: Free public access is stated by Penn State; check current museum visitor information before visiting.

cards.title: Visit the PAC Herbarium
cards.subtitle: PAC Herbarium · University Park campus
cards.notes: Check current visitor options, then explore herbarium materials with a friend and connect what you see to a nearby Arboretum walk.
cards.short_summary: A University Park cultural-site stop built around preserved plant collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State identifies the PAC Herbarium as a University Park museum and states that all University museums and cultural sites have free public access.
cards.source_title: Penn State Sustainability — SDG 11
cards.access_notes: Free public access is stated by Penn State; verify current visitor access and hours before making the trip.

cards.title: Knowledge Commons One Button Studio

cards.notes: Use the camera, projector, iMac, lighting, and microphone to rehearse or record a class presentation; bring files on a USB drive.

cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Libraries lists a One Button Studio in the Knowledge Commons at University Park and describes its recording equipment.

cards.title: Engineering Library One Button Studio
cards.subtitle: Engineering Library • University Park
cards.notes: Set up slides on the iMac, then use the room’s camera and projector for a recorded project presentation or practice run.

cards.entity_name: Earth and Mineral Sciences Library One Button Studio

cards.subtitle: Earth and Mineral Sciences Library • University Park

cards.access_notes: Contact Media Commons for University Park assistance and confirm availability before recording.

cards.entity_name: Physical and Mathematical Sciences Library One Button Studio
cards.title: Physical & Mathematical Sciences One Button Studio
cards.subtitle: Physical and Mathematical Sciences Library • University Park

cards.access_notes: Contact Media Commons for University Park assistance and confirm availability before recording.

cards.title: EMS Library Virtual Reality Center
cards.subtitle: Earth and Mineral Sciences Library • University Park
cards.notes: Book a session to explore STEM-related virtual-reality apps on the HTC Vive system when a class project benefits from immersive visualization.
cards.short_summary: A bookable VR setting for STEM-focused exploration.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Libraries identifies the EMS Library Virtual Reality Center as open to Penn State students and says HTC Vive sessions can be booked.
cards.source_title: Virtual Reality Resources at Penn State | Penn State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: The source says sessions can be booked; verify current booking instructions before going.

cards.title: The Dreamery
cards.subtitle: Basement, Shields Building • University Park
cards.notes: Use this co-learning space to explore VR or AR headsets with classmates, faculty, or staff when testing emerging learning technologies.
cards.short_summary: A Shields Building co-learning space for VR and AR exploration.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Libraries describes The Dreamery in the Shields Building basement as a co-learning space with VR and AR headsets.
cards.source_title: Virtual Reality Resources at Penn State | Penn State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Confirm current access and headset availability with the relevant campus unit before visiting.

cards.title: Immersive Experiences Lab
cards.subtitle: 109 Agricultural Sciences and Industries Building • University Park
cards.notes: Plan a 360-degree media assignment here when you need editing computers, 360 cameras, or headsets in a dedicated creation space.
cards.short_summary: A campus lab equipped for 360-degree media creation and viewing.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State Libraries says the Immersive Experiences Lab in 109 Agricultural Sciences and Industries has 360° video equipment and headsets.
cards.source_title: Virtual Reality Resources at Penn State | Penn State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Confirm current access, equipment availability, and any required training before using the lab.

cards.title: Knowledge Commons Public Computers
cards.subtitle: Pattee Library Knowledge Commons • University Park
cards.notes: Use a public Windows computer when you need campus-installed EndNote X5 to organize citations, references, images, or PDFs.
cards.short_summary: A public-computer option for citation-management work.
cards.evidence_claim: A Penn State Libraries guide states that EndNote X5 is available on public Windows computers in Pattee Library Knowledge Commons.
cards.source_title: EndNote Overview | Penn State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Software availability can change; confirm the current public-computer setup before relying on this location.

cards.title: Sidewater Commons Public Computers
cards.subtitle: Pattee Library • University Park
cards.notes: Choose a public Windows computer here when your research workflow needs the EndNote X5 desktop application and campus library access.
cards.short_summary: A Pattee Library computer area for reference-management tasks.
cards.evidence_claim: A Penn State Libraries guide states that EndNote X5 is available on public Windows computers in Sidewater Commons at University Park.
cards.source_title: EndNote Overview | Penn State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Software availability can change; confirm the current public-computer setup before relying on this location.

cards.title: Warnock Commons Study Space
cards.subtitle: Warnock Commons • North Halls, University Park
cards.notes: Set up in the residence-area study space for a nearby work session, then use the building’s shared amenities during an on-campus break.
cards.short_summary: A study area in the 24-hour Warnock Commons Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State LiveOn says Warnock Commons is open 24 hours a day and includes study space for students.
cards.source_title: North Halls | Penn State LiveOn
cards.access_notes: Penn State LiveOn states that the Warnock Commons Building is open 24 hours/day; follow building and residence-life access rules.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on campus-adjacent downtown corridors, each with a specific documented purpose.

cards.title: College Avenue: campus-gate bakery stop
cards.subtitle: 110 E. College Ave; College Avenue corridor, across from the Allen Street Gates
cards.notes: Use the College Avenue corner as a bakery-and-café stop, then continue through the Allen Street Gates across the street.
cards.short_summary: A documented café directly opposite the campus gates.
cards.evidence_claim: Irving's identifies its location as 110 E. College Ave at Allen Street, directly across from campus by the Allen Street Gates.
cards.source_title: Irving's — Contact
cards.access_notes: Business location; confirm current service details before visiting.

cards.title: College Avenue: see the posted arts program
cards.subtitle: 130 W. College Ave; College Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Check the performance calendar before heading west on College Avenue; the venue lists music, theatre, film, comedy, dance and children’s programming.
cards.short_summary: A community performing-arts venue on the west side of downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: The State Theatre lists its address at 130 West College Avenue and describes programming including concerts, drama, films, dance, comedy and children’s programming.
cards.source_title: The State Theatre — Contact Us
cards.access_notes: Box office hours are listed Monday–Friday, noon–5 p.m.; tickets or event policies may apply.

cards.title: South Allen Street: library stop
cards.subtitle: 211 S. Allen St; South Allen Street corridor
cards.notes: Bring reading or research plans to the public library on South Allen Street; check its program calendar and current building access before you go.
cards.short_summary: A public-library destination anchored on South Allen Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Schlow Centre Region Library lists its address as 211 S. Allen Street in State College.
cards.source_title: Schlow Centre Region Library — Virtual Community Rooms
cards.access_notes: Library programming and service availability can vary; consult the library before visiting.

cards.title: East Beaver Avenue: books and plant-based café
cards.subtitle: 133 E. Beaver Ave; East Beaver Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Browse the bookstore and café at 133 East Beaver Avenue; use the Humes Alley ramp entrance if step-free entry is helpful.
cards.short_summary: A bookstore-café with a documented accessible alternate entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: Webster's lists 133 E. Beaver Ave, identifies itself as a plant-based café, and directs guests needing a ramp entrance to Humes Alley.
cards.source_title: Webster's Bookstore Cafe — Location
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists daily hours; verify them before departure.

cards.title: East Beaver Avenue: gallery and community programs
cards.subtitle: 137 E. Beaver Ave; East Beaver Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Visit during listed open-gallery hours to view art, use the indoor piano, or consult the calendar for an all-ages-appropriate community program.
cards.short_summary: A downtown arts space with gallery hours and a public events calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: 3 Dots Downtown lists 137 East Beaver Avenue and describes daytime gallery hours plus arts and community programming.
cards.source_title: 3 Dots Downtown
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours are Thursday–Saturday, noon–5 p.m.; individual events may have separate details or charges.

cards.title: East College Avenue: campus supplies retail
cards.subtitle: 414 E. College Ave; East College Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use this East College Avenue retail stop for campus-oriented merchandise or in-person returns; bring a receipt for return or exchange requests.
cards.short_summary: A documented student-store location with in-person return service.
cards.evidence_claim: McLanahan's lists its State College address as 414 East College Ave and states that returns may be made in person at its store.
cards.source_title: McLanahan's — Contact Us
cards.access_notes: Retail purchase required for merchandise; return eligibility is subject to the store’s posted policy.

cards.title: East College Avenue: daytime breakfast counter
cards.subtitle: 364 E. College Ave; East College Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Plan a daytime meal stop at the downtown location; its official page lists daily service from 7 a.m. to 2 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A downtown breakfast restaurant with published daily hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Waffle Shop’s official site lists its downtown location at 364 East College Avenue and hours of 7 a.m.–2 p.m. every day.
cards.source_title: The Waffle Shops
cards.access_notes: Officially listed hours are daily, 7 a.m.–2 p.m.; verify holiday service before visiting.

cards.title: East College Avenue: grounds and local history
cards.subtitle: 1001 E. College Ave; East College Avenue corridor at Porter Road
cards.notes: Walk the public gardens and interpretive trail signs, or schedule ahead if you want a mansion tour or archive appointment.
cards.short_summary: Historic grounds beside East College Avenue with self-guided outdoor interpretation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Centre County Historical Society locates Centre Furnace Mansion at 1001 East College Avenue and states that its gardens and walking paths are open to the public from dawn to dusk.
cards.source_title: Centre County Historical Society — Visit Us
cards.access_notes: Gardens and paths are open dawn to dusk; tours and archival research require advance arrangements.

cards.title: South Allen Street: observe local government
cards.subtitle: 243 S. Allen St; South Allen Street corridor
cards.notes: Check the borough calendar and attend an announced public council meeting, or use the building as a civic landmark while walking South Allen Street.
cards.short_summary: The borough’s civic building and regular council-meeting site.
cards.evidence_claim: State College Borough lists the Municipal Building at 243 S. Allen Street and schedules Borough Council meetings there on the first and third Monday of each month.
cards.source_title: State College Borough — Borough Council & Mayor
cards.access_notes: Council meeting schedules may be modified; verify the agenda and meeting calendar before attending.

cards.title: East Beaver Avenue: transit information point
cards.subtitle: 108 E. Beaver Ave; East Beaver Avenue corridor, below Schlow Library
cards.notes: Use the customer-service center for fare and pass questions, lost-and-found help, or transit information before heading farther from campus.
cards.short_summary: A staffed downtown transit-information destination beneath the library.
cards.evidence_claim: CATA lists its Customer Service Center at 108 East Beaver Avenue, below Schlow Centre Region Library, with weekday customer-service hours.
cards.source_title: Centre Area Transportation Authority — Contact
cards.access_notes: Customer Service Center hours are Monday–Friday, 7 a.m.–6 p.m.; it is closed Saturday and Sunday.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Penn State rituals, ceremonies, and recurring campus practices.

cards.title: Answer the “We Are” call
cards.subtitle: A call-and-response heard across Penn State life
cards.notes: Listen for the call, then answer “Penn State”; the University documents its first Beaver Stadium use in 1976 and its lasting campus role.
cards.short_summary: A concise call-and-response that connects Penn Staters at games, ceremonies, and beyond.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State says cheerleaders first used “We Are Penn State” in Beaver Stadium in 1976, and the cheer became permanent by 1981.
cards.source_title: Why we say ‘We Are’ | Penn State University
cards.access_notes: The University describes the cheer as used at Beaver Stadium, freshman welcomes, graduations, and as a greeting.

cards.title: Guard the Lion Shrine
cards.subtitle: Homecoming at the Nittany Lion Shrine
cards.notes: During Homecoming, visit the shrine after the parade to see the Lion Ambassadors’ program centered on protecting the landmark.
cards.short_summary: A Homecoming vigil tied to the campus’s iconic limestone lion.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State states that Lion Ambassadors host Guard the Lion Shrine immediately after each Homecoming parade, based on protecting the statue from rival defacement.
cards.source_title: Student Programs | Penn State Alumni Association
cards.access_notes: Scheduled as part of Homecoming; consult the current Homecoming program for timing.

cards.entity_name: “For the Glory” Penn State Alma Mater
cards.title: Sing “For the Glory of Old State”
cards.subtitle: Penn State’s alma mater
cards.notes: Learn the opening line before a Penn State gathering, then join the communal singalong when it is performed.
cards.short_summary: A song tradition reaching back to Fred Lewis Pattee’s 1901 composition.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State identifies “For the Glory of Old State” as the alma mater’s opening line and says singing it has been a tradition since its 1901 composition.
cards.source_title: Our Traditions | Penn State
cards.access_notes: The University presents the alma mater as a Penn State singalong tradition.

cards.title: Wear white for the White Out
cards.subtitle: Beaver Stadium football tradition
cards.notes: If attending a designated White Out, follow the event guidance and wear white so the stadium’s coordinated crowd effect can take shape.
cards.short_summary: A designated football-game tradition built around a stadium-wide field of white.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State lists the White Out as a signature football tradition in which a roughly 110,000-person crowd wears white.
cards.source_title: Our Traditions | Penn State
cards.access_notes: Occurs for designated football games; game admission and current event details vary.

cards.entity_name: Blue Band Drum Major Forward Flip
cards.title: Watch the drum major’s forward flip
cards.subtitle: Penn State Blue Band pregame pageantry
cards.notes: Watch the Blue Band’s field entrance from a safe spectator location; the drum major’s running forward flip is part of the ritual.
cards.short_summary: A 1971-born Blue Band flourish that became a Penn State football fixture.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State documents that the drum major flip became a Penn State tradition after its 1971 debut and evolved into a running front flip.
cards.source_title: Head over heels for the Blue Band drum major | Penn State University
cards.access_notes: Observe during Blue Band appearances and follow venue staff directions.

cards.title: Learn THON’s hourly Line Dance
cards.subtitle: Penn State IFC/Panhellenic Dance Marathon
cards.notes: Follow the dancers’ lead during THON Weekend; a new routine is designed each year and returns throughout the event.
cards.short_summary: An annually refreshed, repeating dance that keeps THON Weekend moving.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State reports that THON’s Line Dance is performed hourly and that each THON Weekend receives a newly designed dance with unique moves and words.
cards.source_title: THON 2020: The Big Reveal | Penn State University
cards.access_notes: Takes place during THON Weekend; participation and spectator arrangements are event-specific.

cards.title: Follow the Homecoming Parade route
cards.subtitle: University Park and downtown State College
cards.notes: Check the current Homecoming schedule, then watch the parade as it travels through campus and downtown before the shrine program.
cards.short_summary: A long-running Homecoming procession joining students, alumni, and the town.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State says its community has observed Homecoming regularly since 1920 and identifies the parade as one of its oldest traditions.
cards.source_title: The history of Penn State Homecoming: Remembrance, reflection and revelry | Penn State University
cards.access_notes: Annual Homecoming scheduling and route details vary; use the current official program.

cards.title: Take the Lion Shrine photo twice
cards.subtitle: First day and graduation-day photo ritual
cards.notes: Photograph the shrine from the surrounding plaza on your first day, then revisit in cap and gown at graduation without climbing the sculpture.
cards.short_summary: A documented before-and-after photo ritual framing a Penn State degree.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State’s visitor guide describes a tradition of students photographing themselves on the Lion as freshmen and again in caps and gowns at graduation.
cards.source_title: Penn State Visiting Clubs Guide
cards.access_notes: Use the surrounding public area and respect any posted monument-access guidance.

cards.title: Ring the thesis-completion gong
cards.subtitle: Schreyer Honors College thesis tradition
cards.notes: Schreyer Scholars who complete their thesis may ring the gong; visitors can spot it at the Medals Ceremony and in college displays.
cards.short_summary: A thesis milestone marked by one ceremonial gong strike.
cards.evidence_claim: Schreyer Honors College states that, since 2000, only Scholars who have completed their thesis may strike its gong.
cards.source_title: History & Traditions | Schreyer Honors College
cards.access_notes: Ringing is limited to Scholars who have completed their thesis; ceremony access varies.

cards.title: Look for the Old Willow successor
cards.subtitle: Old Main lawn
cards.notes: Pause by the Old Main lawn to see the current willow and learn how Penn State propagates successor trees to continue the campus lineage.
cards.short_summary: A living-campus tradition sustained through successor saplings.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State describes planting an Old Willow sapling on the Old Main lawn as continuing a tradition that spans University history.
cards.source_title: Cultivating the next ‘Old Willow’ | Penn State University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landscape feature; access is subject to campus conditions and posted guidance.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Pennsylvania State University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe first-weekend sequence through University Park landmarks, arts, campus resources, and a Friday-night treat.

cards.title: Friday afternoon — Start at Old Main
cards.subtitle: Old Main lobby, University Park
cards.notes: Step inside during weekday visitor hours to view the land-grant frescoes, then use the lobby as a visual anchor before continuing across campus.
cards.short_summary: A historic first stop centered on the murals inside Penn State’s landmark administration building.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State says visitors can view Old Main’s land-grant frescoes weekdays from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.; the mural installation covers more than 1,300 square feet.
cards.source_title: Hidden Gems: The land-grant frescoes at Old Main
cards.access_notes: Penn State states that visitors can stop in weekdays, 8 a.m.–5 p.m., to view the frescoes.

cards.title: Friday afternoon — Find the Nittany Lion Shrine
cards.subtitle: University Park campus landmark
cards.notes: Walk over for an exterior photo and take a moment to orient yourself; keep this stop simple and avoid climbing on the sculpture or surrounding rocks.
cards.short_summary: A named campus sculpture and recognizable outdoor meeting point.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State identifies the Nittany Lion Shrine at University Park as a landmark that draws visitors and is recognized as one of Pennsylvania’s most photographed landmarks.
cards.source_title: Nittany Lion Shrine | History
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; follow posted campus rules and respect the sculpture.

cards.title: Friday late afternoon — Browse opportunities at the HUB
cards.subtitle: HUB-Robeson Center, University Park
cards.notes: Stop by the Engagement Space to identify one organization, project, or opportunity worth following up on after your first weekend.
cards.short_summary: A campus-based place to turn early curiosity into a concrete next step.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Engagement Network says its Engagement Space is in the HUB-Robeson Center and is equipped with tools and staff to help students identify goals and available opportunities.
cards.source_title: Engagement Space at University Park
cards.access_notes: The space is in the HUB-Robeson Center; ask staff about current availability and programs.

cards.title: Friday early evening — See the HUB galleries
cards.subtitle: First floor of the HUB-Robeson Center
cards.notes: Take a short gallery loop through the HUB Gallery, Art Alley, and exhibition cases; personal photography is encouraged unless an exhibit says otherwise.
cards.short_summary: A free art stop built into the student union’s public spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State says HUB-Robeson Galleries exhibitions are free and open to all, with locations including the HUB Gallery, Art Alley, and exhibition cases on the first floor.
cards.source_title: HUB-Robeson Galleries
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Monday–Friday, 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; personal photography is encouraged unless otherwise noted.

cards.title: Friday night — Visit the Berkey Creamery
cards.subtitle: Corner of Bigler and Curtin Roads
cards.notes: Choose from the current in-store selection and confirm flavors if one matters to you; use the posted location rather than relying on an old campus pin.
cards.short_summary: A campus dairy store with a documented University Park location and evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Berkey Creamery states that its store is at Bigler and Curtin Roads on the University Park campus and lists Friday and Saturday hours until 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: The Store | Penn State Berkey Creamery
cards.access_notes: Posted regular hours: Friday and Saturday 9 a.m.–10 p.m.; check the Creamery page for holiday closures or changes.

cards.title: Saturday morning — Walk the Arboretum
cards.subtitle: East Park Avenue and Bigler Road, University Park
cards.notes: Follow the accessible major walkways through the botanic gardens and bring water; stay on paths and plan to finish before dusk.
cards.short_summary: A free, self-guided outdoor walk through Penn State’s living plant collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arboretum states that it is open daily from dawn to dusk and that there is no admission charge for the H.O. Smith Botanic Gardens or Arboretum land beyond the gardens.
cards.source_title: Hours, Admission, Directions, Parking - The Arboretum at Penn State
cards.access_notes: Open daily dawn to dusk; Penn State notes that all major walkways are accessible.

cards.title: Saturday midday — Enter the Palmer Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: University Park campus museum
cards.notes: Reserve a free timed-entry ticket if available, then move through the galleries at your own pace and check museum guidance before taking photos.
cards.short_summary: A free campus museum visit with timed entry encouraged by the museum.
cards.evidence_claim: The Palmer Museum of Art states that admission is always free and encourages visitors to reserve a free timed-entry ticket to guarantee entrance.
cards.source_title: Know Before You Go
cards.access_notes: Admission is free; the museum encourages a free timed-entry reservation. Confirm current gallery hours and ticketing before leaving.

cards.title: Saturday afternoon — Settle into Pattee/Paterno
cards.subtitle: Pattee/Paterno Library, University Park
cards.notes: Use the library’s public computer labs or printers to handle one practical task, such as checking course systems or organizing your upcoming week.
cards.short_summary: A practical campus-resource stop with publicly listed computer-lab hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State IT lists two computer labs, hallway stations, and printers at Pattee/Paterno Library and publishes University Park operating hours for the location.
cards.source_title: Computer Lab Locations | Information Technology
cards.access_notes: Penn State IT lists hours for the Pattee/Paterno location; verify the current schedule before visiting, especially between terms.

cards.entity_name: Sensory-Friendly Libraries Rooms W023 and W027
cards.title: Saturday afternoon — Locate a quiet reset space
cards.subtitle: Collaboration Commons, West Pattee Library
cards.notes: If a quieter pause would help, locate the two sensory rooms in West Pattee; they are not reservable, so use them considerately and share the space.
cards.short_summary: Two named, walk-in sensory rooms intended for quiet comfort and focused activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State’s Sensory-Friendly Libraries site says rooms W023 and W027 are on the ground floor of West Pattee Library, are not reservable, and are open to anyone who wants to use them.
cards.source_title: Sensory-Friendly Libraries: University Park
cards.access_notes: Rooms W023 and W027 are not reservable and are open to anyone; treat them as shared quiet spaces.

cards.title: Sunday morning — Walk by Beaver Stadium
cards.subtitle: East side of the University Park campus
cards.notes: Use the stadium exterior as the final landmark on your loop, and check campus notices before approaching because revitalization work is ongoing.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus stadium whose exterior can anchor an east-campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Penn State documents that Beaver Stadium was moved and reassembled on the east side of the University Park campus in 1960; current university reporting says revitalization construction began after the 2024 season.
cards.source_title: Intercollegiate Athletics unveils details on Beaver Stadium Revitalization
cards.access_notes: View from public exterior areas only. Penn State reports active revitalization work; obey barriers, event controls, and posted access limits.
